name: Play a free untapped land that unlocks a hand card on turn 1-2
intent: On turn 1 or 2, before anything else about the land drop is decided, play a land from hand that already enters untapped and makes some other hand card payable that is not payable now - a Mountain that lets Lightning Bolt or Monastery Swiftspear be cast. This never costs life and never asks the fetch machinery to run, so it goes first. Prefers a basic Mountain first, never a scarce fetch target; the spec's own second tier, a horizon land paying 1 life for its own colored mana (Fiery Islet's own '{T}, Pay 1 life: Add {U} or {R}.'), is restored right after it (item 3, 2026-09-14 review batch) - the sibling engine's own e1-land-helpers fix (magic-cards-model commit d8c0611) makes payability able to count a {T}+pay-life mana ability, and the api now surfaces it (hypothetical_facts commit 2b61382), so Fiery Islet's own unlocks reads true, confirmed empirically (prowess_islet_unlocks_preordain_t1). Only turns 1-2, only with the land drop still available, and only mine, precombat main, an empty stack. Does not ask about a shockland (open-shock-unlocks) or a fetch (open-fetch-unlocks); those pay something or need a search and rank below this.
